questions.question: You must prevent users from creating resources outside the West Europe and North Europe regions in all subscriptions under a management group. What should you do?

options.text: Assign the Allowed locations policy definition at the management group scope
options.why: Correct. Allowed locations uses the Deny effect, and the assignment is inherited by all child subscriptions.

options.text: Assign the Reader role at the management group scope
options.why: RBAC controls who can act, not where resources can be created.

options.text: Apply a ReadOnly lock to each subscription
options.why: A ReadOnly lock blocks all changes, not only other regions.

options.text: Create a budget filtered by location
options.why: Budgets alert on cost; they do not block deployments.

questions.explanation: Policy assignments at a management group apply to all subscriptions beneath it, including future ones.

questions.question: You assign a policy that uses the Modify effect to add a missing tag to resources. Existing resources remain non-compliant. What should you do?

options.text: Create a remediation task for the policy assignment
options.why: Correct. Remediation tasks apply Modify and DeployIfNotExists effects to existing resources.

options.text: Change the policy enforcement mode to Disabled
options.why: Disabled stops enforcement; it does not fix resources.

options.text: Assign the policy again at the same scope
options.why: A duplicate assignment does not remediate existing resources.

options.text: Create a policy exemption for the resources
options.why: An exemption excludes resources instead of fixing them.

questions.explanation: Modify policies act on create and update requests. Existing resources need a remediation task, which uses the assignment’s managed identity.

questions.question: You plan to assign a policy definition that uses the DeployIfNotExists effect by using Azure CLI. What must the assignment include?

options.text: A managed identity and a location for the identity
options.why: Correct. DeployIfNotExists and Modify assignments need a managed identity to make changes.

options.text: A resource lock on the scope
options.why: Locks are not required and could block remediation.

options.text: An initiative definition
options.why: A single definition can be assigned without an initiative.

options.text: The Owner role for every user in the scope
options.why: Users do not need Owner; the assignment identity performs the deployment.

questions.explanation: Use --mi-system-assigned with --location (or --mi-user-assigned), and grant the identity the required role.

questions.question: You need to evaluate how many existing resources would violate a new policy before the policy blocks any deployment. Which two approaches meet the requirement? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.

options.text: Assign the definition with the Audit effect
options.why: Correct. Audit reports non-compliance without blocking.

options.text: Assign the definition with policy enforcement set to Disabled
options.why: Correct. DoNotEnforce evaluates compliance without applying the effect.

options.text: Assign the definition with the Deny effect and an exemption for every resource
options.why: This is impractical and still blocks new deployments.

options.text: Apply a CanNotDelete lock before assigning the policy
options.why: Locks do not evaluate policy compliance.

questions.explanation: Audit and enforcement mode Disabled let you measure compliance safely before enforcing Deny.

questions.question: You need to apply 12 related policy definitions to several subscriptions and manage them as a single unit with one compliance score. What should you create?

options.text: An initiative definition
options.why: Correct. An initiative groups policy definitions into one assignable set.

options.text: A management group for each definition
options.why: Management groups organize subscriptions, not definitions.

options.text: A custom RBAC role
options.why: RBAC roles grant permissions; they do not group policies.

options.text: Twelve resource locks
options.why: Locks do not evaluate or group policies.

questions.explanation: Initiatives (policy set definitions) simplify assignment and report compliance for the whole set.
